newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish April construction costs up 2.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish April construction costs up 2.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Construction costs rose 0.3 percent in April on March, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Wednesday.
The construction costs index rose 2.1 percent year-on-year in April, it said. In March, the year-on-year rise was 2.0 percent, up from 1.7 percent in February.
Year-on-year, material input costs rose 2.1 percent and labour costs increased 3.3 percent. Other input costs rose 0.3 percent, SF said.
Month-on-month, both material and labour costs rose 0.3 percent and other input costs increased 0.1 percent.
